title: MDA SPACE NAMED INAUGURAL SPACE PARTNER OF THE DENVER BRONCOS
summary: TORONTO, ON (SEPTEMBER 22, 2026) – MDA Space Ltd. (TSX:MDA) (NYSE:MDA), a trusted mission partner to the global defence and space industry, today announced
body_markdown:
***New partnership expands the MDA Space brand presence through one of the NFL’s most recognized franchises***


**TORONTO, ON (SEPTEMBER 22, 2026)** – MDA Space Ltd. (TSX:MDA) (NYSE:MDA), a trusted mission partner to the global defence and space industry, today announced a new partnership with the Denver Broncos of the National Football League (NFL), becoming the team’s first official space industry partner.


Through the agreement, MDA Space will gain brand visibility at Empower Field at Mile High and across Broncos digital platforms, helping introduce the MDA Space story to new audiences in one of the most important space, aerospace and defence communities in the United States.


“This partnership strengthens our commitment to a region where space, defence and innovation are deeply connected,” said Mike Greenley, CEO, MDA Space. “The Denver Broncos are an iconic organization with a powerful platform across Colorado and beyond. As MDA Space continues to grow, this partnership gives us a meaningful way to build our brand and connect with new audiences.”


The partnership also carries a fitting connection to space: Empower Field at Mile High sits at the highest elevation in the NFL, giving the Broncos the unique position of being the closest NFL team to space.


As an official partner of the Denver Broncos, MDA Space will be featured through in-stadium, digital and fan-facing activations designed to highlight the focus, coordination and technical excellence common to both game-day performance and space operations.


“MDA Space represents the innovation, ambition and pioneering spirit that we value at the Denver Broncos,” said Dennis Moore, Broncos Chief Commercial Officer. “We're proud to welcome them as our first-ever Official Space Partner and to partner with a company that reflects Colorado's leadership in the space and aerospace industry.”


The partnership also reflects MDA Space’s broader growth strategy in the U.S. market, where the company is focused on expanding awareness of its advanced space and defence technology capabilities and its role supporting critical missions for government and commercial customers.

The global MDA Space team of more than 4,000 space experts has the knowledge and know-how to turn an audacious customer vision into an achievable mission — bringing to bear a one-of-a-kind mix of experience, engineering excellence and wide-eyed wonder that’s been in our DNA since day one.
